card.name: Family lineage and kinship phrasing
card.fires_on: Words in biographical text that point to family ties, such as father of, son of, grandson of, belonging to a family, or part-way through a family surname. The next word is expected to be a relative or a family name.

modes.label: Kinship link words
modes.description: Words like of or to right after father, son, grandson or belonging, introducing a relative or family.
modes.example: Belonging<< to>> a prominent Venetian family, F

modes.label: Inside family surnames
modes.description: Partway through a family name or title in genealogical text.

modes.label: The word family
modes.description: The word family or a relative noun in descriptions of a lineage.
modes.example: came from an interesting<< family>>. His maternal grandfather had been the leader

card.writes: It pushes down family-word predictions such as family, relatives and spouse, and slightly raises resource-type words.
card.plain: It fires in biographies when the text is about to name someone's family or relatives.
